entries.en: Dimitri's Restaurant, in the city of Akos, southern Tyche.
entries.zh: 堤刻南部，阿科斯城，迪米特里的餐馆。

entries.en: BEN: Hey Lydia, is the boss in back?
entries.zh: BEN: 嘿，莉迪娅，老板在后面吗？

entries.en: LYDIA: Oh... Ben. No, he's not.
entries.zh: LYDIA: 啊……本。他不在。

entries.en: BEN: I know he's here. His truck is out front.
entries.zh: BEN: 我知道他在。他的车就停在门口。

entries.en: BEN: Did he tell you to keep me out?
entries.zh: BEN: 是他让你拦着我的？

entries.en: LYDIA: It's just a bad time. Like, a REALLY bad time. You should come back later.
entries.zh: LYDIA: 现在不方便。真的，特别不方便。你还是过会儿再来吧。

entries.en: BEN: Like when? During my shift? I'm not working for free.
entries.zh: BEN: 过会儿？等我上班的时候？我可不白干。

entries.en: BEN: He's bounced two paychecks.
entries.zh: BEN: 他给我的工资支票，已经有两张兑不出来了。

entries.en: LYDIA: Stop! There are plumbers back there. It stinks!
entries.zh: LYDIA: 别进去！后面有水管工，臭得很！

entries.en: BEN: Oh, so he has money for plumbers but not his cook!?
entries.zh: BEN: 哦，请水管工就有钱，给厨师发工资就没钱了！？

entries.en: BEN: Wait a second, why do all these plumbers have guns?
entries.zh: BEN: 等等，水管工怎么个个都带着枪？

entries.en: BEN: Ow, dammit!
entries.zh: BEN: 哎哟，该死！

entries.en: MOBSTER: Nothing in the safe, boss. The whole place is empty.
entries.zh: MOBSTER: 老大，保险柜里什么都没有。这地方已经被掏空了。

entries.en: CODRESCU: Alright, Dimitri. This is the last time I'm asking nicely. Where's my money?
entries.zh: CODRESCU: 好，迪米特里。我最后再客客气气地问你一遍。我的钱呢？

entries.en: CODRESCU: If you don't tell me, I'll shoot this guy right here in your kitchen.
entries.zh: CODRESCU: 再不说，我就在你这厨房里，一枪崩了这家伙。

entries.en: BEN: Hang on a second.
entries.zh: BEN: 等一下。

entries.en: BEN: He owes me money, too. I haven't been paid in four weeks.
entries.zh: BEN: 他也欠我钱。我已经四个星期没领到工资了。

entries.en: BEN: So if anything, we're on the same side.
entries.zh: BEN: 所以真要说起来，咱们才是一伙的。

entries.en: CODRESCU: Is that right, Dimitri? You've been holding out on everyone? What was your plan?
entries.zh: CODRESCU: 是吗，迪米特里？谁的钱你都敢赖？你打的什么算盘？

entries.en: CODRESCU: To retire somewhere I couldn't find you? Get a house on an island?
entries.zh: CODRESCU: 找个我寻不着的地方退休？去小岛上买栋房子？

entries.en: CODRESCU: There's nowhere I can't find you! Now tell me where my money is!
entries.zh: CODRESCU: 你躲到哪儿我都找得到！说，我的钱在哪儿！

entries.en: BEN: Honestly...
entries.zh: BEN: 说真的……

entries.en: BEN: I don't think he has it. He's got a gambling problem.
entries.zh: BEN: 我觉得他是真没钱了。他赌瘾不小。

entries.en: Dimitri: Ben, do you ever shut up?
entries.zh: Dimitri: 本，你就不能闭上嘴吗？

entries.en: CODRESCU: Oh, you like games of chance? How about this?
entries.zh: CODRESCU: 哦，喜欢赌？那咱们这么玩。

entries.en: CODRESCU: I'm gonna flip a coin, and if it comes up heads, I'm gonna shoot your brother.
entries.zh: CODRESCU: 我抛个硬币。正面，我就一枪崩了你兄弟。

entries.en: CODRESCU: If it comes up tails, I'm gonna take my time with your cook.
entries.zh: CODRESCU: 反面，我就慢慢收拾你的厨师。

entries.en: BEN: I really want to emphasize that you and I are in the same boat with the whole money thing.
entries.zh: BEN: 我得再强调一下，说到讨债，咱们可是一条船上的人。

entries.en: CODRESCU: Tails.
entries.zh: CODRESCU: 反面。

entries.en: CODRESCU: Bring 'em outside.
entries.zh: CODRESCU: 把他们带出去。

entries.en: BEN: Gentlemen, I know I'm repeating myself, but...
entries.zh: BEN: 各位，虽然这话我已经说过了，可是……

entries.en: CODRESCU: Don't try to kill him right away. But if it happens, it happens.
entries.zh: CODRESCU: 别急着弄死他。不过，真死了也就死了。

entries.en: BEN: I can be reasonable. We'll split my paycheck! How's 60-40, in your favor?
entries.zh: BEN: 好商量嘛！我工资分你们一份！四六开，你们六，怎么样？

entries.en: BEN: Okay, okay! We'll do it 70-30!
entries.zh: BEN: 行行行！三七开！

entries.en: BEN: I'm... back home.
entries.zh: BEN: 我……回家了。

entries.en: BEN: Ah, crap! I'm late for work!
entries.zh: BEN: 坏了！上班迟到了！

entries.en: BEN: Huh?
entries.zh: BEN: 嗯？

entries.en: DARIO: He's awake.
entries.zh: DARIO: 他醒了。

entries.en: BEN: Why is my apartment full of bodybuilders?
entries.zh: BEN: 我屋里怎么来了一群练健美的？

entries.en: AGATA: I am Agata, of the Order of the Phylax.
entries.zh: AGATA: 我是守护者团的阿伽塔。

entries.en: AGATA: You are Ben Balani?
entries.zh: AGATA: 你就是本·巴拉尼？

entries.en: BEN: The one and only.
entries.zh: BEN: 如假包换。

entries.en: AGATA: Three days ago, you manifested magical powers for the first time.
entries.zh: AGATA: 三天前，你第一次显现了魔法能力。

entries.en: BEN: So... that really happened?
entries.zh: BEN: 所以……那事儿是真的？

entries.en: AGATA: Yes.
entries.zh: AGATA: 是的。

entries.en: BEN: Aren't I a little...
entries.zh: BEN: 我是不是有点……

entries.en: BEN: ...too old for that?
entries.zh: BEN: ……过了那个年纪？

entries.en: BEN: I thought only mysterious orphans got magic powers.
entries.zh: BEN: 我还以为只有身世神秘的孤儿才会获得魔法。

entries.en: AGATA: No, it is possible for anyone to manifest magical powers, at any time.
entries.zh: AGATA: 不是。任何人都有可能在任何时候显现魔法能力。

entries.en: AGATA: But it is much more common in children.
entries.zh: AGATA: 只是儿童更常见。

entries.en: BEN: Well, thanks for the heads up. I gotta get to work.
entries.zh: BEN: 好，多谢提醒。我得上班去了。

entries.en: AGATA: I beg your pardon?
entries.zh: AGATA: 你说什么？

entries.en: BEN: Unless you can use magic to make it rain money, I still need to get my paycheck from Dimitri.
entries.zh: BEN: 除非你能施法让天上下钱，不然我还是得找迪米特里领工资。

entries.en: BEN: My landlord isn't going to care whether I have magic or not.
entries.zh: BEN: 房东可不管我会不会魔法。

entries.en: LANDLORD: You're damn right I don't care! Rent's due next week!
entries.zh: LANDLORD: 没错，我才不管！下星期交房租！

entries.en: BEN: Mind your own business, you nosy bastard!
entries.zh: BEN: 管好你自己，少偷听别人说话！

entries.en: DARIO: Can you deal with him? I've been here all night.
entries.zh: DARIO: 你来应付他吧？我在这儿守一夜了。

entries.en: AGATA: Yes.
entries.zh: AGATA: 好。

entries.en: AGATA: Very well, then. Let us go.
entries.zh: AGATA: 那么，走吧。

entries.en: BEN: Wait, what? Go to my work? You're... coming along?
entries.zh: BEN: 等等，什么？去我上班的地方？你……也来？

entries.en: AGATA: Yes.
entries.zh: AGATA: 是的。

entries.en: BEN: Great! Maybe you can lift Dimitri by his ankles and shake the change out of his pockets.
entries.zh: BEN: 太好了！到时候你拎着迪米特里的脚踝，把他口袋里的零钱抖出来。

entries.en: BEN: It's just down the street, a few blocks west of here.
entries.zh: BEN: 就在这条街上，往西走几个街口。

entries.en: BEN: Can't say I like what they've done with the place.
entries.zh: BEN: 这地方的新造型，我可欣赏不来。

entries.en: AGATA: Do you understand what this means?
entries.zh: AGATA: 你明白这意味着什么吗？

entries.en: BEN: Dimitri can pay me out of the insurance money?
entries.zh: BEN: 迪米特里能拿保险赔款给我发工资了？

entries.en: AGATA: I... do not think you appreciate the seriousness of this situation.
entries.zh: AGATA: 我……觉得你还没意识到事态有多严重。

entries.en: BEN: That's been a theme in my life.
entries.zh: BEN: 我这辈子老有人这么说。

entries.en: AGATA: There is something here.
entries.zh: AGATA: 这里有东西。

entries.en: AGATA: Monsters from the wilds...
entries.zh: AGATA: 是野外的魔物……

entries.en: BEN: So does this sort of thing happen a lot when you're a wizard?
entries.zh: BEN: 当了巫师，就经常碰上这种事吗？

entries.en: AGATA: The word is "mage." And no, it is not common.
entries.zh: AGATA: 是“法师”。而且，这种事并不常见。

entries.en: AGATA: But wild creatures are attracted to powerful sources of magic.
entries.zh: AGATA: 不过，野生生物会被强大的魔力源吸引。

entries.en: AGATA: The only reason it would enter a city is because you released so much magical energy all at once.
entries.zh: AGATA: 它会进城，是因为你一次释放了太多魔力。

entries.en: AGATA: Now do you understand?
entries.zh: AGATA: 现在明白了吗？

entries.en: BEN: Yeah, nobody's gonna hire a cook who shoots lightning. So I need a new job.
entries.zh: BEN: 明白了。没人会雇个乱放闪电的厨师。我得另找份工作。

entries.en: AGATA: I will take you to the magical academy, where you will learn to control your magic.
entries.zh: AGATA: 我会带你去魔法学院，学习控制自己的魔法。

entries.en: AGATA: The food and lodging are not luxurious, but there is no cost.
entries.zh: AGATA: 食宿虽然简陋，但不收钱。

entries.en: AGATA: The journey is not far. I will show you the way, and then you can retrieve your possessions when-
entries.zh: AGATA: 学院不远。我先带你认路，再让你回来收拾……

entries.en: AGATA: ...?
entries.zh: AGATA: ……？

entries.en: BEN: Someone in the marketplace must need magic.
entries.zh: BEN: 市场里总有人用得上魔法吧。

entries.en: WIFE: Those are good oranges.
entries.zh: WIFE: 这橙子不错。

entries.en: HUSBAND: But I don't want to pay city prices.
entries.zh: HUSBAND: 可我不想掏城里这个价。

entries.en: WIFE: Then why'd we come to the city?
entries.zh: WIFE: 那咱们进城干什么？

entries.en: BEN: Anyone need some magic? Freelance magic, made to order.
entries.zh: BEN: 谁需要魔法服务？独立经营，按需施法！

entries.en: HUSBAND: Not at city prices.
entries.zh: HUSBAND: 城里的价钱就免了。

entries.en: GIRL: I wish the ice cream man showed up earlier.
entries.zh: GIRL: 卖冰淇淋的怎么还不来呀。

entries.en: WOMAN: He gets elected, then spends all day chasing skirts!
entries.zh: WOMAN: 选上了就整天追着女人跑！

entries.en: SECOND WOMAN: Oh it's the worst. My sister works at city hall, and he tried to grab her on the first day!
entries.zh: SECOND WOMAN: 可不是嘛。我妹妹在市政厅工作，头一天他就想动手动脚！

entries.en: WOMAN: I hear the deputy mayor is the one who really runs the show.
entries.zh: WOMAN: 听说真正管事的是副市长。

entries.en: BEN: Either of you need a freelance wizard to do some work?
entries.zh: BEN: 二位需要找个独立经营的巫师干点活吗？

entries.en: WOMAN: You look more like a freelance butter and cookie salesman.
entries.zh: WOMAN: 你倒像是独立经营黄油饼干生意的。

entries.en: BEN: I'll take that as a no.
entries.zh: BEN: 那我就当二位不需要了。

entries.en: BEN: (But the cookie thing has potential....)
entries.zh: BEN: （不过，卖饼干好像有门儿……）

entries.en: BEN: Hey, you looking to hire a freelance wizard?
entries.zh: BEN: 嘿，要雇个独立经营的巫师吗？

entries.en: MAN: You know there's a mages guild for that, right?
entries.zh: MAN: 这事儿有法师公会管，你知道吧？

entries.en: BEN: That sounds expensive. I can give you a big discount.
entries.zh: BEN: 听着就贵。我可以给你打个大折。

entries.en: MAN: I don't know. The only thing worse than paying full price is getting cheap service.
entries.zh: MAN: 不好说。花钱贵是烦，可贪便宜吃亏更烦。

entries.en: BEN: (Tough crowd...)
entries.zh: BEN: （这生意不好做啊……）

entries.en: MAN: I think I'll pass, pal.
entries.zh: MAN: 还是算了吧，老兄。

entries.en: MAN: The guy who runs the shop across the street is definitely cheating on his taxes. There's no way he's outselling me.
entries.zh: MAN: 街对面那个开店的肯定偷税了。他的生意怎么可能比我好。

entries.en: MAN: You're sure there's not a lower price if it's all cash?
entries.zh: MAN: 我全付现金，真不能再便宜点？

entries.en: MAN: I'm telling you, they're going to raise the retirement age. There's just not enough workers.
entries.zh: MAN: 跟你说，退休年龄肯定要往后推。干活的人根本不够。

entries.en: MAN: Huh? I'm not buying anything.
entries.zh: MAN: 啊？我不买东西。

entries.en: MAN: That's political suicide! Nobody wants to work for 25 years!
entries.zh: MAN: 那他们就别想再当选了！谁愿意干二十五年活啊！

entries.en: MAN: Get out of here; I don't like the look of you.
entries.zh: MAN: 走开。看你就不像什么好人。

entries.en: BEN: Hey, are you looking for some low-budget magic?
entries.zh: BEN: 嘿，要不要来点实惠的魔法服务？

entries.en: FARMER: How low-budget are we talking?
entries.zh: FARMER: 能实惠到什么程度？

entries.en: BEN: Depends what I'm doing.
entries.zh: BEN: 得看干什么活。

entries.en: FARMER: Can you use magic to bust up some old trees?
entries.zh: FARMER: 能用魔法劈掉几棵老树吗？

entries.en: BEN: Well, I can call the lightning...
entries.zh: BEN: 这个嘛，我能招来闪电……

entries.en: BEN: And lightning can bust up a tree...
entries.zh: BEN: 闪电嘛，确实能劈树……

entries.en: BEN: (So maybe I charge the same as a large catering order?)
entries.zh: BEN: （那就按承包一场大宴席的价钱算？）

entries.en: BEN: How about six hundred?
entries.zh: BEN: 六百怎么样？

entries.en: FARMER: Ehhh... how about five hundred?
entries.zh: FARMER: 嗯……五百吧？

entries.en: BEN: ... alright fine. So where are they?
entries.zh: BEN: ……行吧。树在哪儿？

entries.en: FARMER: Back at my farm! We'll take my truck.
entries.zh: FARMER: 我农场里！坐我的车去。

entries.en: FARMER: Let me know when yer ready.
entries.zh: FARMER: 准备好了就告诉我。

entries.en: FARMER: Ya ready to go?
entries.zh: FARMER: 能走了吗？

entries.en: Not yet...
entries.zh: 还没……

entries.en: Let's go!
entries.zh: 走吧！

entries.en: BEN: So, just this stump?
entries.zh: BEN: 就这个树桩？

entries.en: FARMER: What? No! I've pulled out hundreds of stumps. I don't need magic for that.
entries.zh: FARMER: 什么？当然不是！我都拔过几百个树桩了，用得着魔法？

entries.en: FARMER: You're here to bust up those ones over there.
entries.zh: FARMER: 请你来是对付那边那几棵的。

entries.en: BEN: Oh.
entries.zh: BEN: 哦。

entries.en: BEN: Well, they're just trees, right?
entries.zh: BEN: 再怎么说，不也就是几棵树嘛？

entries.en: FARMER: Oh no, they've definitely got some kind of evil inside them.
entries.zh: FARMER: 那可不对，里面肯定藏着什么邪门的东西。

entries.en: FARMER: Anyway, let 'em have it!
entries.zh: FARMER: 总之，放手劈吧！

entries.en: BEN: Alright... even big scary trees can be blown up by lightning.
entries.zh: BEN: 好……树再大再吓人，闪电也照样劈得动。

entries.en: BEN: Okay, I guess I could do that one more time.
entries.zh: BEN: 行，再来一次应该也成。

entries.en: AGATA: You.
entries.zh: AGATA: 你。

entries.en: AGATA: Why did you leave?
entries.zh: AGATA: 为什么擅自离开？

entries.en: BEN: Wow, you're pretty good at finding people, huh?
entries.zh: BEN: 哇，找人还真是你的拿手活啊？

entries.en: AGATA: Yes. Now we must go to the magical academy.
entries.zh: AGATA: 是。现在我们必须去魔法学院。

entries.en: BEN: Look, I had a really bad time in school. At least let me blow up this last tree and collect my pay.
entries.zh: BEN: 听我说，我上学那会儿可没少遭罪。好歹先让我劈完这最后一棵，把工钱拿了。

entries.en: AGATA: Your pay?
entries.zh: AGATA: 工钱？

entries.en: BEN: Yeah, I'm getting paid to blow up evil trees.
entries.zh: BEN: 对啊。有人雇我炸掉邪恶的树。

entries.en: BEN: I can't believe that sentence just came out of my mouth.
entries.zh: BEN: 这话居然能从我嘴里说出来，我自己都不敢信。

entries.en: AGATA: Is this true?
entries.zh: AGATA: 是这样吗？

entries.en: FARMER: Yep! And he's got one more to go.
entries.zh: FARMER: 对！还剩一棵。

entries.en: FARMER: Might as well hurry up. I'm not paying by the hour.
entries.zh: FARMER: 快点吧。我可不是按钟头付钱的。

entries.en: BEN: Yeah, yeah.
entries.zh: BEN: 知道了，知道了。

entries.en: ENGINEER: So, that's how you fixed your truck, huh?
entries.zh: ENGINEER: 原来你就是这么修好卡车的啊？

entries.en: BEN: Hey buddy, you still need help with that machine you were building?
entries.zh: BEN: 嘿，老兄，你造的那台机器还需要帮忙吗？

entries.en: ENGINEER: What? No! As soon as you leave it stops working!
entries.zh: ENGINEER: 什么？不用了！你一走，它就不转了！

entries.en: BEN: I mean, I could just sit next to it.
entries.zh: BEN: 那我就坐在旁边呗。

entries.en: ENGINEER: That's not the point. Also, you melted the internal components of my prototype when you touched it.
entries.zh: ENGINEER: 问题不在这儿。而且，你碰原型机的时候，把里面的零件都熔了。

entries.en: BEN: So you could use me as a space heater...?
entries.zh: BEN: 那……拿我当暖炉用？

entries.en: ENGINEER: No.
entries.zh: ENGINEER: 不用。

entries.en: ENGINEER: I said no.
entries.zh: ENGINEER: 我说了，不用。

entries.en: MERCHANT: This guy isn't from around here, is he?
entries.zh: MERCHANT: 这家伙不是本地人吧？

entries.en: MERCHANT: What kind of currency were they using...?
entries.zh: MERCHANT: 他们那边用的什么钱来着……？

entries.en: BEN: Hey, do you still need some work done?
entries.zh: BEN: 嘿，还有活儿需要人干吗？

entries.en: MERCHANT: What? No! You left a cyclone going in my store room!
entries.zh: MERCHANT: 什么？没有！你在我仓库里留了个龙卷风！

entries.en: BEN: It won't happen again, I promise!
entries.zh: BEN: 我保证，下不为例！

entries.en: MERCHANT: What do you mean "again?" That cyclone is STILL going!
entries.zh: MERCHANT: 什么叫“下不为例”？那个龙卷风到现在还没停呢！

entries.en: BEN: (That's actually kind of impressive...)
entries.zh: BEN: （这么说，我还挺厉害……）

entries.en: MERCHANT: No, thank you.
entries.zh: MERCHANT: 不用了，谢谢。

entries.en: BEN: Hey, you still need help?
entries.zh: BEN: 嘿，还需要帮忙吗？

entries.en: FARMER: What? You burned the fur off all my sheep! And now every time there's thunder they run into the river!
entries.zh: FARMER: 什么？你把我所有羊的毛都烧光了！现在一打雷，它们就往河里跑！

entries.en: BEN: Yeah, but you have to admit... they move a lot faster now.
entries.zh: BEN: 是，可你得承认……它们现在跑得快多了。

entries.en: FARMER: Not interested.
entries.zh: FARMER: 不需要。

entries.en: FARMER: Not this time, sonny.
entries.zh: FARMER: 这回就算了，小子。

entries.en: BEN: Man...
entries.zh: BEN: 唉……

entries.en: BEN: Doesn't ANYONE need me?
entries.zh: BEN: 就没一个人用得上我吗？

entries.en: AGATA: There he is.
entries.zh: AGATA: 他在那儿。

entries.en: BEN: Anyone except them.
entries.zh: BEN: 他们不算。

entries.en: AGATA: You. Come here.
entries.zh: AGATA: 你，过来。

entries.en: BEN: The Phylax and city cops are in cahoots now? I'm not ready for this.
entries.zh: BEN: 守护者团现在跟城里警察联手了？这阵仗我可受不了。

entries.en: AGATA: Come with us, there is work to be done.
entries.zh: AGATA: 跟我们走。有工作要做。

entries.en: BEN: I don't want to work with them. They'll probably make me stand in front of a bus to test the brakes.
entries.zh: BEN: 我不想跟他们干。他们八成会让我站到公交车前面，试试刹车灵不灵。

entries.en: AGATA: You will be fine. Now come along.
entries.zh: AGATA: 你不会有事。走吧。

entries.en: BEN: My humors are out of balance. I have too much black bile...
entries.zh: BEN: 我体液失调。黑胆汁太多……

entries.en: BEN: ... and not enough phlegm.
entries.zh: BEN: ……黏液又不够。

entries.en: AGATA: We do not need this performance.
entries.zh: AGATA: 不必演了。

entries.en: PACHIS: Look, buddy, this is a gig. Seems like you need it.
entries.zh: PACHIS: 老兄，这是份有钱拿的活儿。你不是正缺钱吗？

entries.en: KARRAS: Mikelakis said he'd give you seven thousand.
entries.zh: KARRAS: 米克拉基斯说给你七千。

entries.en: BEN: SEVEN THOUSAND!?
entries.zh: BEN: 七千！？

entries.en: BEN: That's an... irresponsible amount of money.
entries.zh: BEN: 这钱给得……也太不负责任了吧。

entries.en: AGATA: Then you will come with us.
entries.zh: AGATA: 那就跟我们来。

entries.en: AGATA: We are looking for a cavern, northeast of the city, past the marshes.
entries.zh: AGATA: 我们要找的洞穴在城东北，穿过沼泽就到。

entries.en: BEN: So... what am I doing here?
entries.zh: BEN: 所以……我来这儿干什么？

entries.en: BEN: Is there a bear in the cave? Am I supposed to poke the bear?
entries.zh: BEN: 洞里有熊？叫我来捅熊的？

entries.en: AGATA: There is a source of magic inside that cave somewhere. An illegal kind of magic.
entries.zh: AGATA: 洞穴里有一处魔力源。用的是违法的魔法。

entries.en: BEN: And you want me to... what? Find this magic and rub it into my face and armpits? See if I develop a rash?
entries.zh: BEN: 所以你们要我……干吗？找到那魔法，往脸上和腋窝里抹一抹，看会不会起疹子？

entries.en: DARIO: Look, you're getting paid a lot of money, right?
entries.zh: DARIO: 你拿的钱可不少，对吧？

entries.en: DARIO: Why don't you start by clearing the ward at the mouth of the cave?
entries.zh: DARIO: 要不先把洞口的结界清了？

entries.en: BEN: Fine.
entries.zh: BEN: 行吧。

entries.en: BEN: Ward, huh? Maybe if...
entries.zh: BEN: 结界是吧？试试这样……

entries.en: BEN: It's just a... simple thread...
entries.zh: BEN: 不就是……一根细线嘛……

entries.en: BEN: BOOM!
entries.zh: BEN: 轰！

entries.en: BEN: Jerks.
entries.zh: BEN: 一群混蛋。

entries.en: BEN: I'm pretty sure that ward was just to keep out animals.
entries.zh: BEN: 我看这结界就是用来挡野兽的。

entries.en: BEN: So, time for lunch.
entries.zh: BEN: 好了，该吃午饭了。

entries.en: AGATA: No. We will go in. The four of us will enter this way.
entries.zh: AGATA: 不行。我们进去。四个人从这里进。

entries.en: DARIO: I'll look for the other entrance. Gotta be at least one.
entries.zh: DARIO: 我去找别的入口。肯定还有一个。

entries.en: AGATA: Ready yourselves.
entries.zh: AGATA: 做好准备。

entries.en: BEN: Three.
entries.zh: BEN: 三。

entries.en: BEN: Two.
entries.zh: BEN: 二。

entries.en: BEN: One.
entries.zh: BEN: 一。

entries.en: BEN: Zero.
entries.zh: BEN: 零。

entries.en: BEN: Can't leave town, I need to pay the rent!
entries.zh: BEN: 还不能出城，我得交房租！

entries.en: BEN: Okay, hang on a sec.
entries.zh: BEN: 好，先等一下。

entries.en: BEN: Are we not gonna talk about what just happened?
entries.zh: BEN: 刚才那事儿，咱们就这么揭过去了？

entries.en: KARRAS: Teleportation magic. It was part of the briefing.
entries.zh: KARRAS: 传送魔法。任务说明里讲过。

entries.en: BEN: What briefing?
entries.zh: BEN: 什么任务说明？

entries.en: AGATA: We need to keep moving.
entries.zh: AGATA: 我们得继续走。

entries.en: BEN: Stop.
entries.zh: BEN: 站住。

entries.en: BEN: I'm not going any further until I get some answers.
entries.zh: BEN: 不给我个说法，我哪儿也不去。

entries.en: AGATA: Fine.
entries.zh: AGATA: 好吧。

entries.en: BEN: Who builds a gigantic laboratory in the middle of nowhere? And how?
entries.zh: BEN: 谁会在这种荒郊野岭建个这么大的实验室？又是怎么建的？

entries.en: AGATA: Judging by the haphazard layout and many blockages, it was probably built by automatons.
entries.zh: AGATA: 布局杂乱，通道也多处堵塞，很可能是自动机械建的。

entries.en: BEN: If this job is such a big deal, why isn't your fancy "Mages Guild" doing it? It can't just be the money.
entries.zh: BEN: 这差事要真那么重要，你们那个了不起的“法师公会”怎么不来？总不能光是钱的问题吧。

entries.en: AGATA: There was an incident, not long ago.
entries.zh: AGATA: 前不久出过一场事故。

entries.en: AGATA: A wandering mage came to Akos. He scorned the Guild, and so he made his own contract with the city government.
entries.zh: AGATA: 一个流浪法师来到阿科斯。他看不上公会，便自行与市政府签了契约。

entries.en: AGATA: In exchange for his... unique services... the city government sheltered him from the Guild and the Phylax.
entries.zh: AGATA: 作为他提供……特殊服务的回报，市政府替他挡下了公会和守护者团的干涉。

entries.en: AGATA: He trained his own apprentices and performed magical experiments.
entries.zh: AGATA: 他自己收学徒，做魔法实验。

entries.en: AGATA: It ended in a catastrophe. Since then, the Guild and the mayor's office have been in conflict.
entries.zh: AGATA: 最后酿成了灾难。从那以后，公会与市长办公室就一直不和。

entries.en: BEN: Not a lot of details in that story.
entries.zh: BEN: 这故事讲得还真够笼统。

entries.en: PACHIS: I was there when it happened.
entries.zh: PACHIS: 出事的时候，我在场。

entries.en: PACHIS: A lot of the people who went to contain it died. Guild members, phylax, city cops...
entries.zh: PACHIS: 去控制事态的人死了很多。公会成员、守护者、城里的警察……

entries.en: PACHIS: ...friends of mine.
entries.zh: PACHIS: ……还有我的朋友。

entries.en: BEN: You know what?
entries.zh: BEN: 你知道吗？

entries.en: BEN: If you had just told me that, I would've helped you.
entries.zh: BEN: 你们要是早这么说，我就会帮忙了。

entries.en: AGATA: We must be getting close.
entries.zh: AGATA: 应该快到了。

entries.en: BEN: Hey, it's the guy from before. Magico, or whatever.
entries.zh: BEN: 嘿，是之前那家伙。魔法佬，还是什么来着。

entries.en: MAGICO: That's not my n... what am I saying? I don't have to answer to you.
entries.zh: MAGICO: 那不是我的名……我在说什么？我没必要跟你解释。

entries.en: MAGICO: This is my domain. Leave now.
entries.zh: MAGICO: 这是我的领地。立刻离开。

entries.en: BEN: Actually, he's got a point. Don't we need to show him a warrant, or something?
entries.zh: BEN: 其实他说得也有道理。咱们是不是得先亮个搜查令什么的？

entries.en: AGATA: These are forbidden experiments. Nothing like this is legal south of the isthmus.
entries.zh: AGATA: 这些都是违禁实验。在地峡以南，没有一样合法。

entries.en: MAGICO: I'm in an underground bunker, 25 miles away from the nearest settlement.
entries.zh: MAGICO: 我待在地下掩体里，离最近的聚落也有二十五英里。

entries.en: MAGICO: You had to use this idiot here to even find this place, didn't you?
entries.zh: MAGICO: 要不是带着这个蠢货，你们连这里都找不到，对吧？

entries.en: BEN: Okay, you're losing points with me now.
entries.zh: BEN: 行，你这话我就不爱听了。

entries.en: AGATA: The law is the law. You know why it exists.
entries.zh: AGATA: 法律就是法律。你知道它为何存在。

entries.en: MAGICO: Because regressive cowards are afraid of facing true genius?
entries.zh: MAGICO: 因为一群顽固的懦夫害怕真正的天才？

entries.en: MAGICO: My work will not hurt anybody. In fact, soon I will leave this realm altogether.
entries.zh: MAGICO: 我的研究不会伤害任何人。事实上，我很快就会彻底离开这一方天地。

entries.en: MAGICO: That's what THIS is for.
entries.zh: MAGICO: 这就是它的用途。

entries.en: AGATA: Magical doors are forbidden.
entries.zh: AGATA: 魔法门是被禁止的。

entries.en: MAGICO: Without even knowing where they go?
entries.zh: MAGICO: 连它们通向哪里都不知道，就禁止？

entries.en: MAGICO: Perhaps I should just show you.
entries.zh: MAGICO: 不如让你们亲眼看看。

entries.en: BEN: Uh... no?
entries.zh: BEN: 呃……还是不了吧？

entries.en: MAGICO: Behold!
entries.zh: MAGICO: 看好了！

entries.en: MAGICO: This duel is growing tiresome.
entries.zh: MAGICO: 这场决斗越来越无趣了。

entries.en: MAGICO: Do you still think that I am endangering your benighted little city?
entries.zh: MAGICO: 现在还觉得，我会危及你们那座蒙昧的小城吗？

entries.en: MAGICO: What... is...
entries.zh: MAGICO: 什……么……

entries.en: BEN: Y-you just MURDERED him!
entries.zh: BEN: 你、你就这么把他杀了！

entries.en: DARIO: Yeah, you gotta get 'em when they're distracted.
entries.zh: DARIO: 对啊，就是要趁他们分神的时候下手。

entries.en: BEN: But like...
entries.zh: BEN: 可是……

entries.en: BEN: We're in HIS house!
entries.zh: BEN: 是我们闯进他家来的啊！

entries.en: AGATA: You do not understand. This is the law.
entries.zh: AGATA: 你不明白。这就是法律。

entries.en: BEN: Doesn't he get a trial!?
entries.zh: BEN: 连审判都没有吗！？

entries.en: BEN: Am I talking to myself, here!?
entries.zh: BEN: 有没有人在听我说话！？

entries.en: ????: Es wurde aktiviert.
entries.zh: ????: Es wurde aktiviert.

entries.en: BEN: Who are they...?
entries.zh: BEN: 他们是谁……？

entries.en: ????: Hail. Vere is de magos? Who are all of you?
entries.zh: ????: 问候。法师，在哪个地方？你们都是谁？

entries.en: BEN: Well, I guess he was telling the truth.
entries.zh: BEN: 看来他还真没说谎。

entries.en: ????: What is happen-
AGATA: We need to leave!
entries.zh: AGATA: 我们得走了！

entries.en: AGATA: Now!
entries.zh: AGATA: 现在！

entries.en: BEN: I'm on it!
entries.zh: BEN: 交给我！

entries.en: BEN: Gotcha!
entries.zh: BEN: 接住你了！

entries.en: AGATA: WE ARE FALLING!
entries.zh: AGATA: 我们在往下掉！

entries.en: AGATA: THROUGH THE SKY!
entries.zh: AGATA: 从天上往下掉！

entries.en: BEN: Relax, going down is the easy part.
entries.zh: BEN: 放心，下来可比上去容易。

entries.en: BEN: We're not even moving that fast anymore.
entries.zh: BEN: 现在已经没掉得那么快了。

entries.en: AGATA: I... wh...
entries.zh: AGATA: 我……怎……

entries.en: AGATA: What happened?
entries.zh: AGATA: 刚才怎么回事？

entries.en: BEN: I used the portal to teleport us out of the lab.
entries.zh: BEN: 我用传送门把咱们送出了实验室。

entries.en: AGATA: Wh... where are the others?
entries.zh: AGATA: 其……其他人呢？

entries.en: BEN: They're fine. They came out a lot closer to the ground.
entries.zh: BEN: 他们没事。他们出来的时候离地面近多了。

entries.en: AGATA: But then... why...
entries.zh: AGATA: 可是……为什么……

entries.en: BEN: I'm gonna bring us down in that clearing over there. Hang on a sec.
entries.zh: BEN: 我带咱们落到那边的空地上。稍等一下。

entries.en: BEN: Aaaand...
entries.zh: BEN: 好——了……

entries.en: BEN: Dinner is ready.
entries.zh: BEN: 开饭。

entries.en: BEN: Watch out for bones in the fish. I didn't have my filet knives with me and it's kinda hard to see at night.
entries.zh: BEN: 小心鱼刺。我没带剔鱼刀，天黑也看不太清。

entries.en: AGATA: This is... delicious. How did you...?
entries.zh: AGATA: 这……真好吃。你是怎么……？

entries.en: BEN: You remember the part where I've been a cook my whole life, right?
entries.zh: BEN: 你还记得我说过，自己做了一辈子厨师吧？

entries.en: AGATA: But where did you get the ingredients?
entries.zh: AGATA: 可食材是哪里来的？

entries.en: BEN: I caught the fish in the stream, found a few herbs and mushrooms in the woods.
entries.zh: BEN: 鱼是溪里捉的，香草和蘑菇是林子里找的。

entries.en: BEN: A little olive oil and garlic, and boom! Dinner.
entries.zh: BEN: 再来点橄榄油和蒜，齐活！这不就有饭吃了。

entries.en: AGATA: You found olive oil and garlic in the woods?
entries.zh: AGATA: 你在林子里找到了橄榄油和蒜？

entries.en: BEN: No, I carry olive oil and garlic with me at all times. I'm not a barbarian.
entries.zh: BEN: 没有，橄榄油和蒜我都随身带着。我又不是野蛮人。

entries.en: BEN: So the whole phylax thing. Your job is to... kill mages?
entries.zh: BEN: 说起来，你们守护者的工作就是……杀法师？

entries.en: AGATA: That is not entirely correct.
entries.zh: AGATA: 不完全是。

entries.en: AGATA: Our mission is to prevent the use of dangerous magic.
entries.zh: AGATA: 我们的使命是制止危险魔法的使用。

entries.en: BEN: And that Magico guy... he was a dangerous mage?
entries.zh: BEN: 所以那个魔法佬……是个危险的法师？

entries.en: AGATA: You are old enough to remember, there used to be other cities on this peninsula.
entries.zh: AGATA: 你这个年纪，应该还记得半岛上曾经有过别的城市。

entries.en: AGATA: But magical powers can emerge in anyone. Sometimes... in the wrong person, in the wrong place.
entries.zh: AGATA: 可是任何人都可能显现魔法能力。有时……偏偏是不该得到它的人，偏偏是在不该出现的地方。

entries.en: AGATA: And that is simply the way the world works. The order is our attempt to save what is left of civilization.
entries.zh: AGATA: 这就是世界运转的方式。我们成立守护者团，是为了保住所剩无几的文明。

entries.en: BEN: So this whole time you've been trying to figure out if you're going to kill me?
entries.zh: BEN: 所以这一路上，你都在琢磨要不要杀我？

entries.en: AGATA: You must understand...
entries.zh: AGATA: 你要明白……

entries.en: AGATA: We thought you were not who you claimed to be. Your name was not in city birth records.
entries.zh: AGATA: 我们以为你隐瞒了身份。城里的出生记录中没有你的名字。

entries.en: AGATA: Nobody knows anything about you, personally. You have always lived alone.
entries.zh: AGATA: 没有人了解你的私事。你一直独居。

entries.en: BEN: Yeah, I, uh... chop a lot of vegetables.
entries.zh: BEN: 是啊，我，呃……平时忙着切菜呢。

entries.en: AGATA: And you were able to use that man's portal, without ever seeing it before. The order will not like that.
entries.zh: AGATA: 而且，你从没见过那人的传送门，却能直接使用。团里不会乐于见到这种事。

entries.en: AGATA: I know that you are not a threat. But I do not know if I can convince the rest of the order.
entries.zh: AGATA: 我知道你不会构成威胁。但我不知道能不能说服其他人。

entries.en: BEN: I have another question. Actually, it's more of a story. Can I tell you?
entries.zh: BEN: 我还有个问题。其实更像是个故事。能讲给你听吗？

entries.en: AGATA: I have never been able to stop you from talking.
entries.zh: AGATA: 我从来就没拦住过你说话。

entries.en: BEN: So you said you couldn't find anything about me when I was young?
entries.zh: BEN: 你说，查不到我小时候的事？

entries.en: BEN: Well... part of the reason is I lived way, waaay out in the boonies.
entries.zh: BEN: 嗯……一部分原因，是我那时候住得太偏了。偏得不能再偏。

entries.en: BEN: It was a big old shack on a mountainside, beside a stream.  The rest of the mountain was woods, but by the stream we had a little clearing.
entries.zh: BEN: 山坡上有间又大又破的屋子，旁边是条小溪。山上全是树林，就溪边有块小空地。

entries.en: BEN: Huh?
entries.zh: BEN: 嗯？

entries.en: BEN: It's almost like I'm there...
entries.zh: BEN: 简直像是回来了……

entries.en: AGATA: We are there. Is your magic creating this illusion?
entries.zh: AGATA: 我们就在这里。是你的魔法制造了幻象？

entries.en: BEN: How should I know?
entries.zh: BEN: 我哪知道？

entries.en: ????: Hey, Ben!
BEN: Oh, hey, Stani. How ya doin'?
entries.zh: BEN: 哦，斯塔尼。怎么样啊？

entries.en: STANI: Great! Boris and Mika are still passed out!
entries.zh: STANI: 好得很！鲍里斯和米卡还醉得不省人事呢！

entries.en: STANI: I've been eating from the butter churn all morning.
entries.zh: STANI: 我整个上午都在偷吃搅乳桶里的黄油。

entries.en: BEN: You don't think they'll notice?
entries.zh: BEN: 不怕他们发现？

entries.en: STANI: What are they gonna do? They already don't feed me.
entries.zh: STANI: 发现又能怎样？反正他们也不给我饭吃。

entries.en: STANI: If they want it back, they can check the outhouse this afternoon.
entries.zh: STANI: 想要回去，下午上茅房里找呗。

entries.en: STANI: See ya!
entries.zh: STANI: 走啦！

entries.en: BEN: I seem to remember he ate a lot of bugs.
entries.zh: BEN: 我记得他好像还吃过不少虫子。

entries.en: BEN: Let's go, I wanna show you something.
entries.zh: BEN: 走，带你看个东西。

entries.en: SIGN: Welcome to the Seaside Cottage! Make sure to take your shoes off before entering.
entries.zh: SIGN: 欢迎来到海滨小屋！进门前请务必脱鞋。

entries.en: BEN: (Okay, someone up the street must need magic.)
entries.zh: BEN: （好，这条街上总有人用得着魔法。）

entries.en: BEN: (I'm gonna ask around, and I'm not gonna take no for an answer.)
entries.zh: BEN: （挨个问问。这回可不能让他们随便打发了。）

entries.en: 1/3 Humiliating Rejections
entries.zh: 惨遭拒绝：1/3

entries.en: 2/3 Humiliating Rejections
entries.zh: 惨遭拒绝：2/3

entries.en: 3/3 Humiliating Rejections
entries.zh: 惨遭拒绝：3/3

entries.en: 0/3 Humiliating Rejections
entries.zh: 惨遭拒绝：0/3

entries.en: BEN: Here we go.
entries.zh: BEN: 来吧。

entries.en: BEN: Okay, I'm done getting my ass kicked by trees.
entries.zh: BEN: 好了，这辈子不想再挨树揍了。

entries.en: BEN: We're all done here.
entries.zh: BEN: 活儿干完了。

entries.en: FARMER: Yep, come on and get your pay.
entries.zh: FARMER: 行，过来拿钱吧。

entries.en: FARMER: (She's a keeper, by the way. Good strong bones. I bet she could get a lot of work done around a farm.)
entries.zh: FARMER: （顺便说一句，这姑娘可得留住。身板结实，放农场里肯定能干不少活。）

entries.en: AGATA: What is beyond these trees?
entries.zh: AGATA: 树后面是什么地方？

entries.en: FARMER: Old swamp. You know, typical den of evil and unsavory things. Eerie lights at night, moaning fogs by day.
entries.zh: FARMER: 老沼泽。你知道的，那种邪物扎堆的地方。晚上冒怪光，白天雾里有呻吟声。

entries.en: AGATA: When did these strange occurrences start?
entries.zh: AGATA: 这些怪事是什么时候开始的？

entries.en: FARMER: Oh, I'd say about late last harvest season. Big thunderstorm came through, flooded the place. Been an accursed mire pretty much ever since.
entries.zh: FARMER: 大概上个收获季快结束的时候。来了一场大雷暴，把那儿淹了。从那以后，就成了这片受诅咒的烂泥潭。

entries.en: AGATA: You.
entries.zh: AGATA: 你。

entries.en: BEN: It's Ben.
entries.zh: BEN: 我叫本。

entries.en: AGATA: There is dangerous magic beyond here. You and I will investigate its source.
entries.zh: AGATA: 前面有危险的魔法。你和我一起去查清来源。

entries.en: BEN: Am I getting paid?
entries.zh: BEN: 有工钱吗？

entries.en: AGATA: No. But if you do not assist me, I will drag you to the magical academy.
entries.zh: AGATA: 没有。但你要是不配合，我就把你拖去魔法学院。

entries.en: BEN: Alright, fine.
entries.zh: BEN: 行吧，行吧。

entries.en: FARMER: (Oh, and she's a feisty one, too? Good luck, sonny!)
entries.zh: FARMER: （哟，脾气还挺辣？祝你好运，小子！）

entries.en: AGATA: Let us go.
entries.zh: AGATA: 走吧。

entries.en: AGATA: ...
entries.zh: AGATA: ……

entries.en: FARMER: Well, don't just stand there! Get to it!
entries.zh: FARMER: 别光站着了！动手吧！

entries.en: FARMER: I can spot ya a potion or two if ya want!
entries.zh: FARMER: 要是需要，我可以先给你一两瓶药！

entries.en: BEN: Can't leave without getting paid!
entries.zh: BEN: 工钱还没拿，可不能走！

entries.en: AGATA: No. Not until we discover the source of the magic.
entries.zh: AGATA: 不行。必须先查清魔法的来源。

entries.en: AGATA: This must be the source, but...
entries.zh: AGATA: 源头应该就是这里，可是……

entries.en: ????: Who are you?
entries.zh: ????: 你们是谁？

entries.en: AGATA: I am Agata, free member of the Order of the Phylax.
entries.zh: AGATA: 我是阿伽塔，守护者团的自由成员。

entries.en: BEN: I'm Ben, the cook.
entries.zh: BEN: 我是本，厨师。

entries.en: ????: What are you doing in my woods, Phylaka?
entries.zh: ????: 守护者，你来我的树林做什么？

entries.en: AGATA: Magic is corrupting the local wildlife.
entries.zh: AGATA: 魔法正在侵蚀附近的野生生物。

entries.en: ????: So what? This is a solitary place.
entries.zh: ????: 那又怎样？这里与世隔绝。

entries.en: AGATA: No. The local farms are seeing the effects.
entries.zh: AGATA: 并非如此。附近的农场已经受到了影响。

entries.en: AGATA: And the law is the law.
entries.zh: AGATA: 而且，法律就是法律。

entries.en: BEN: Okay, I feel like maybe I'm out of the loop, here.
entries.zh: BEN: 好吧，我是不是又有什么事不知道？

entries.en: ????: Is this what the mighty Phylax have come to?
entries.zh: ????: 大名鼎鼎的守护者团，已经沦落到这地步了？

entries.en: AGATA: The law is the law. You know what that means.
entries.zh: AGATA: 法律就是法律。你知道这意味着什么。

entries.en: ????: I don't have time to waste on you.
entries.zh: ????: 我没工夫陪你们浪费时间。

entries.en: <align="center">But I can't have you following me...</align>
entries.zh: <align="center">不过，也不能让你们跟着我……</align>

entries.en: BEN: Well, I'm ready to call it a day.
entries.zh: BEN: 行，我准备收工了。

entries.en: BEN: Maybe grab a cup of tea and some stuffed grape leaves...
entries.zh: BEN: 找杯茶喝，再来点葡萄叶包饭……

entries.en: BEN: Sorry you didn't catch that guy. Good luck with that.
entries.zh: BEN: 没抓到那家伙，真可惜。祝你接下来好运。

entries.en: AGATA: Tell me something.
entries.zh: AGATA: 回答我一个问题。

entries.en: AGATA: Why are there no records of your origin? The name "Ben Balani" only appeared 20 years ago.
entries.zh: AGATA: 为什么查不到你的来历？“本·巴拉尼”这个名字，二十年前才第一次出现。

entries.en: BEN: It's a long story.
entries.zh: BEN: 说来话长。

entries.en: BEN: But I actually pay my taxes, so you must know that I worked at Dimitri's Restaurant for the past nine years.
entries.zh: BEN: 不过，我可是按时交税的。你肯定查得到，我在迪米特里的餐馆干了九年。

entries.en: BEN: And before that, the diner over on Agora street, for eleven years.
entries.zh: BEN: 再之前，在阿戈拉街那家小饭馆干了十一年。

entries.en: AGATA: But where were you before that? There are no school records for you.
entries.zh: AGATA: 更早以前呢？没有你的入学记录。

entries.en: BEN: I went to a small school up in the mountains. I wasn't there for very long.
entries.zh: BEN: 我在山里一所小学校上过学。没待多久。

entries.en: AGATA: Why?
entries.zh: AGATA: 为什么？

entries.en: BEN: They couldn't teach me how to read.
entries.zh: BEN: 他们教不会我认字。

entries.en: AGATA: I can read Tycish and it is not my first language.
entries.zh: AGATA: 堤刻语不是我的母语，连我都能读。

entries.en: BEN: I don't know what to tell you.
entries.zh: BEN: 我也不知道该怎么跟你说。

entries.en: BEN: When I look at words on a page, they start to run together after a second.
entries.zh: BEN: 纸上的字，我盯着看一会儿，就全挤成一团了。

entries.en: AGATA: Then how were you able to run an entire kitchen and keep track of all the orders?
entries.zh: AGATA: 那你怎么管得了整个厨房，还能记住所有点单？

entries.en: BEN: I dunno, I just kept it all in my head.
entries.zh: BEN: 不知道，全记在脑子里呗。

entries.en: AGATA: (Maybe that's why he can't control his power...?)
entries.zh: AGATA: （也许这就是他无法控制力量的原因……？）

entries.en: BEN: Here we go again.
entries.zh: BEN: 又来了。

entries.en: BEN: Why are you here?
entries.zh: BEN: 你怎么在这儿？

entries.en: DARIO: This is my job, remember?
entries.zh: DARIO: 这是我的工作，记得吗？

entries.en: BEN: To come into my apartment and drink my tea?
entries.zh: BEN: 你的工作就是来我家蹭茶喝？

entries.en: DARIO: You didn't have any coffee. Also, I had to make sure your powers didn't go off during the night.
entries.zh: DARIO: 你这儿没咖啡。而且，我得确保你夜里不会乱放魔法。

entries.en: BEN: Okay, I'm DEFINITELY too old for that.
entries.zh: BEN: 好吧，这种事我肯定已经过了年纪了。

entries.en: BEN: Anyway, I gotta go find work again today.
entries.zh: BEN: 总之，我今天还得出去找活儿。

entries.en: BEN: So, if you could stop freeloading, that'd be great. Rent in this city is insane, and every teabag counts, buddy.
entries.zh: BEN: 你要是能少蹭点就更好了。这城里的房租贵得发疯，老兄，一包茶也是钱。

entries.en: DARIO: Agata was right about you.
entries.zh: DARIO: 阿伽塔还真没说错你。

entries.en: BEN: I'm hard-working and full of charm?
entries.zh: BEN: 勤劳肯干，魅力十足？

entries.en: DARIO: You're full of something.
entries.zh: DARIO: 你倒确实有样东西挺足的。

entries.en: BEN: Great. See you soon.
entries.zh: BEN: 好极了。回头见。

entries.en: DARIO: I'm just gonna finish my tea and be on my way.
entries.zh: DARIO: 喝完这杯茶我就走。

entries.en: BEN: I'm getting a really bad feeling, right about now.
entries.zh: BEN: 我这会儿的预感，可不太妙。
